measured.text:
Built 13 Oct 2026, and live in the app on every page's own screen in Google Analytics → All pages.

The Kapferer article, last 12 months, United Kingdom:
• 593 visits started on it; 1 conversion (£20), from a visit typed in; Google's 446 made none
• 1.0 different pages a visit, counted as 3.5 with repeats
• 62.5% of its views are the same page counted again; 35.9% leave
• Read to the end: 6.1% of visits (Content hub 8.7%)
• Readers worldwide: UK 457, India 205, South Africa 133, Brazil 99
• 16 downloads of the prism template PDF

examples.text:
On this board, some rows are still examples (each source's split, devices, weekdays). The app shows the real figures.

Added at Anthony's ask: each age and gender chart also says how many of the page's conversions Google could place, and shows them on its bars.
